title: Twinkle Star Sprites
native_title: ティンクル・スター・スプライツ
overview:
A Dream Versus Shooter!

A super-arranged Sega Saturn Mode - here in powered-up form!

The shooting gamer's dream: a versus shooting game finally arrives on the Sega Saturn!!

The evil Mevious has stolen the Twinkle Star, a magical treasure that grants any wish, and the young fairy princess Load Ran sets out to win it back. Two players fly side by side through split-screen vertical stages, blasting waves of enemies. Destroyed enemies explode and set off chains, and every chain sends fireballs over to your rival's side. Shoot incoming fireballs to bounce them back, charge your shot for special attacks, and build your power meter to send a boss after your opponent. Knock out your rival's hearts to win the round.

- Story Mode with voiced cut scenes, Character Mode with an ending for each fighter, and a two-player versus mode
- Sega Saturn Mode with an animated opening, arranged music and a new character, plus an Arcade Mode faithful to the original
- Bonus disc, the Twinkle Star Eternal Box, packed with artwork and alternate versions of the opening theme
